brief:
Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan condemned Gaza as an "ecocide" at the Cop31 climate summit held in Turkey, Middle East Eye reported. Erdogan characterized climate change as "one of the deepest existential crises" in humanity's history during his remarks at the conference.

The statement marked Erdogan's use of the international climate forum to address the environmental devastation in Gaza, linking the conflict to broader climate concerns.

title: Erdogan condemns Gaza 'ecocide' at climate summit
